brief:
Settlers attacked the home of Youssef Shanaran, who has been besieged for approximately 50 days in Wadi al-Rakhim near Masafer Yatta in southern Hebron, Maan Wire reported. The attack marks an escalation against the isolated residence.

Shanaran's home has remained under siege for roughly seven weeks in the Palestinian community of Wadi al-Rakhim, located in the Masafer Yatta area south of Hebron.
title: Settlers attack isolated Palestinian home in southern Hebron
